sections.heading: Declare Multiple Variables
sections.body: To declare more than one variable of the same type, use a comma-separated list:

sections.heading: Example
sections.body: Note: All variables must be of the same type. You cannot mix types in the same declaration. You can also assign the same value to multiple variables at once:
sections.code:
int x = 5, y = 6, z = 50;

  printf("%d", x + y + z);

sections.heading: Example
sections.body: Tip: Declaring multiple variables on one line is convenient, but declaring them on separate lines can make your code easier to read.
